title: Project Objectives
lede: Research and development goals guiding the EvoSim artificial life simulation, defining both the broad scientific target and specific technical deliverables.

general.title: General Objective
general.description: To design and develop a competitive survival simulation where a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), trained by an evolutionary algorithm, learns to effectively control animal behavior. The project demonstrates how evolutionary processes can optimize a neural network's decision-making capabilities for survival within a dynamic, resource-limited, and hazardous environment.

specific.title: Animal Classification
specific.detail: Classify animals into three distinct categories (herbivore, carnivore, omnivore) with unique survival skills, baseline stats, and passive behaviors.

specific.title: Evolutionary Training Pipeline
specific.detail: Create a training system driven by evolutionary algorithms where animals iteratively improve survival behaviors by facing diverse survival challenges across generations.

specific.title: Multi-Layered Event Architecture
specific.detail: Design and implement a multi-layered event system featuring AI-driven Movement Events, player-interactive Quick Events, simulation-wide Random Events, and hazardous Disasters occurring on structured weekly cycles.

specific.title: Competitive Survival Environment
specific.detail: Develop a competitive survival arena where AI-driven animals governed by MLPs experience generational selection within an unpredictable, resource-constrained ecosystem.

specific.title: Status-Driven Decision Making
specific.detail: Enable the MLP to select basic actions (moving, hunting, foraging, drinking, resting) based on the animal's real-time internal Status inputs: Health, Hunger, Thirst, Energy, and Instinct.

specific.title: Behavioral Event Simulation
specific.detail: Simulate diverse behavioral encounters including predatory hunting, seasonal migration, and contested resource gathering.

specific.title: Heterogeneous Terrain Ecology
specific.detail: Construct an interactive environment featuring diverse terrain biomes including plains, forest, jungle, lake, and mountains with variable traversal penalties.

specific.title: Real-Time Stat & Skill Visualization
specific.detail: Display animal survival metrics and evolutionary adaptations dynamically based on live status telemetry.
